name: NTT UD REIT Investment Corporation
summary: NTT Urban Development REIT Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the Investment Corporation). In accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Act) and was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on September 10, 2002 (stock code 8956).
